# 3-Week Reconditioning Block for Return to Training

## Client Overview
- 41M, intermediate lifter
- 3 weeks detraining post-flu
- 4kg bodyweight loss, residual fatigue
- Pre-illness lifts: Bench 100kg, Squat 140kg, Deadlift 170kg
- Full gym access

---

## Programme Philosophy

This block prioritises **nervous system re-engagement** and **metabolic restoration** over intensity. We're rebuilding movement patterns, work capacity, and confidence rather than chasing numbers. Expect 70–80% of pre-illness loads initially, progressing to 85–90% by week 3. Volume is moderate; frequency is maintained to rebuild neural pathways quickly.

---

## Week 1: Reactivation & Movement Quality

**Focus:** Low-intensity movement, movement quality, appetite/calorie restoration, sleep prioritisation.

**Training frequency:** 4 sessions (Upper/Lower split)

### Session 1A: Lower Body (Monday)

*Warm-up: 5min easy bike, leg swings, bodyweight squats*

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Goblet Squat | 3 | 8 | 16kg | Controlled tempo, 2sec pause |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 8 | 80kg | Focus on hip hinge, light |
| Leg Press | 3 | 10 | 60kg | Moderate depth, no lockout strain |
| Leg Curl | 2 | 10 | 30kg | Controlled, 2sec squeeze |
| Calf Raise | 2 | 12 | Bodyweight | Light, high reps |

*Cool-down: 5min walk, static stretching (quads, hamstrings, hip flexors)*

---

### Session 1B: Upper Body (Tuesday)

*Warm-up: 5min rowing, arm circles, band pull-aparts*

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Dumbbell Bench Press | 3 | 8 | 20kg each | Controlled descent, 2sec pause |
| Bent-Over Barbell Row | 3 | 8 | 60kg | Light, focus on scapular retraction |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 2 | 10 | 15kg each | Moderate incline, higher reps |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 10 | 40kg | Controlled, full range |
| Face Pulls | 2 | 12 | 12kg | Rear delt activation, light |

*Cool-down: 5min rowing, stretching (chest, lats, shoulders)*

---

### Session 1C: Lower Body (Thursday)

*Warm-up: 5min bike, dynamic leg swings*

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Trap Bar Deadlift | 3 | 6 | 100kg | Lighter than pre-illness; focus on form |
| Front Squat (or Goblet) | 3 | 8 | 50kg | Upright posture, controlled |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 10 | 40kg | Quad activation, light |
| Nordic Curl (assisted) | 2 | 5 | Band assist | Eccentric strength, hamstring prep |
| Sled Push | 2 | 20m | Light | Metabolic finisher, easy pace |

*Cool-down: 5min walk, stretching*

---

### Session 1D: Upper Body (Friday)

*Warm-up: 5min rowing, scapular activation*

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Barbell Bench Press | 3 | 6 | 70kg | Reintroduce main lift, light |
| Pendlay Row | 3 | 8 | 70kg | Controlled, scapular focus |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 2 | 10 | 18kg each | Accessory volume |
| Chest-Supported Row | 2 | 10 | 50kg | Reduce lower back demand |
| Dumbbell Flyes | 2 | 12 | 12kg each | Pec stretch, light |

*Cool-down: 5min rowing, stretching*

---

## Week 2: Intensity Ramp & Confidence Building

**Focus:** Gradual load increase, re-establish work capacity, introduce moderate intensity.

**Training frequency:** 4 sessions (same split)

### Session 2A: Lower Body (Monday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Squat | 4 | 5 | 110kg | 78% of pre-illness; build confidence |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 6 | 100kg | Increase from week 1 |
| Leg Press | 3 | 8 | 80kg | Moderate intensity |
| Leg Curl | 3 | 8 | 40kg | Increase volume |
| Sled Push | 2 | 30m | Moderate | Metabolic work |

---

### Session 2B: Upper Body (Tuesday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Bench Press | 4 | 5 | 80kg | 80% of pre-illness |
| Barbell Row | 4 | 5 | 85kg | Match bench intensity |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 | 8 | 18kg each | Accessory volume |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 8 | 50kg | Increase from week 1 |
| Face Pulls | 2 | 15 | 15kg | Shoulder health |

---

### Session 2C: Lower Body (Thursday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Deadlift | 3 | 3 | 130kg | 76% of pre-illness; technical focus |
| Front Squat | 3 | 6 | 70kg | Increase from week 1 |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 10 | 50kg | Quad volume |
| Nordic Curl (assisted) | 3 | 5 | Lighter band | Eccentric strength |
| Sled Push | 2 | 40m | Moderate | Conditioning |

---

### Session 2D: Upper Body (Friday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Bench Press | 3 | 6 | 85kg | Increase reps, build volume |
| Pendlay Row | 3 | 6 | 85kg | Match bench progression |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 3 | 8 | 20kg each | Increase load |
| Chest-Supported Row | 3 | 8 | 60kg | Increase from week 1 |
| Dumbbell Flyes | 2 | 10 | 14kg each | Pec work |

---

## Week 3: Return to Baseline

**Focus:** Approach pre-illness loads, restore confidence, prepare for normal programming.

**Training frequency:** 4 sessions (same split)

### Session 3A: Lower Body (Monday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Squat | 4 | 5 | 130kg | 93% of pre-illness; should feel strong |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 5 | 110kg | Increase intensity |
| Leg Press | 3 | 8 | 100kg | Solid volume |
| Leg Curl | 3 | 8 | 45kg | Increase from week 2 |
| Sled Push | 2 | 50m | Moderate-heavy | Conditioning finisher |

---

### Session 3B: Upper Body (Tuesday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Bench Press | 4 | 5 | 95kg | 95% of pre-illness |
| Barbell Row | 4 | 5 | 95kg | Match bench |
| Incline Dumbbell Press | 3 | 8 | 22kg each | Accessory strength |
| Lat Pulldown | 3 | 8 | 55kg | Solid volume |
| Face Pulls | 3 | 12 | 18kg | Shoulder health |

---

### Session 3C: Lower Body (Thursday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Deadlift | 3 | 3 | 160kg | 94% of pre-illness; technical |
| Front Squat | 3 | 6 | 85kg | Solid accessory work |
| Leg Extension | 3 | 10 | 55kg | Quad volume |
| Nordic Curl (assisted) | 3 | 5 | Minimal band | Eccentric strength |
| Sled Push | 2 | 60m | Moderate-heavy | Conditioning |

---

### Session 3D: Upper Body (Friday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| Bench Press | 3 | 6 | 92kg | Solid volume at near-baseline |
| Pendlay Row | 3 | 6 | 92kg | Match bench |
| Dumbbell Incline Press | 3 | 8 | 24kg each | Accessory strength |
| Chest-Supported Row | 3 | 8 | 70kg | Solid volume |
| Dumbbell Flyes | 2 | 10 | 16kg each | Pec work |

---

## Nutrition & Recovery Recommendations

### Calorie & Protein Intake
- **Calories:** Client lost 4kg; prioritise **+300–500kcal above maintenance** to restore bodyweight and glycogen. Aim for 2.5–3kg gain over 3 weeks.
- **Protein:** 1.8–2.2g per kg bodyweight daily (approximately 140–170g for a ~75kg male). Distribute across 4–5 meals.
- **Carbs:** Front-load around training (40–50g pre-workout, 40–60g post-workout). Restore glycogen aggressively.
- **Fats:** 0.8–1.2g per kg bodyweight; prioritise omega-3s for recovery.

### Meal Timing
- **Pre-workout (60–90min before):** Oats + banana + almond butter, or rice cakes + honey + whey.
- **Post-workout (within 60min):** Whey protein + white rice + berries, or chicken + sweet potato + broccoli.
- **Between sessions:** Snack on Greek yogurt, nuts, fruit, or protein shakes.

### Sleep & Recovery
- **Sleep target:** 7–9 hours nightly. Fatigue is still present; prioritise sleep over extra training.
- **Stress management:** Light walking on off-days (20–30min), mobility work, foam rolling.
- **Hydration:** 3–4L water daily; increase if sweating heavily.
- **Supplements (optional):** Multivitamin, vitamin D (if deficient), omega-3s, creatine monohydrate (5g daily).

### Off-Days (Wed, Sat, Sun)
- **Wednesday:** 20–30min easy walk or light yoga. Mobility work (10min).
- **Saturday:** Complete rest or 15–20min easy bike/walk.
- **Sunday:** Complete rest. Meal prep for the week.

---

## Monitoring & Progression Cues

### Week-to-Week Adjustments
- **If fatigue persists:** Reduce volume by 1–2 sets per session; add an extra rest day.
- **If strength returns quickly:** Increase loads by 2.5–5kg per session (lower body) or 2.5kg per side (upper body).
- **If appetite is poor:** Add liquid calories (smoothies, whole milk, oat milk) to boost intake without fullness.

### End-of-Block Assessment (Week 3, Friday)
By the final session, your client should:
- Squat 130kg+ (93%+ of baseline)
- Bench 95kg+ (95%+ of baseline)
- Deadlift 160kg+ (94%+ of baseline)
- Report normal energy levels and appetite
- Move with confidence and good form

If these targets are met, return to normal periodised programming. If not, extend this block by 1 week at week 3 intensity.

---

## Session Structure Template

Each session follows this format:
1. **Warm-up (5–10min):** Easy cardio + dynamic mobility
2. **Main lifts (compound, 3–4 sets):** Lower reps (3–6), higher intensity
3. **Accessory work (2–3 exercises, 2–3 sets):** Moderate reps (8–12), hypertrophy/stability
4. **Finisher (optional):** Light conditioning (sled, bike, rowing) or core work
5. **Cool-down (5–10min):** Static stretching, breathing

---

## Summary

This 3-week block is **conservative by design**. Your client is recovering from illness and detraining; the goal is to restore movement quality, confidence, and bodyweight before returning to normal programming. Expect steady 5–10% weekly load increases. Monitor fatigue closely—if he reports persistent tiredness, dial back intensity and prioritise sleep and nutrition. By week 3, he should feel ready to resume his normal training cycle.
